basic_details.post_name: District Programme Manager, Ayush Medical Officer, Yoga & Naturopathy and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: National Ayush Mission, Zilla Parishad Wardha (ZP Wardha), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 4 posts in 4 roles. The posts include District Programme Manager, Ayush Medical Officer, Yoga & Naturopathy, Dietitian. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand draft of a nationalised bank payable to District Ayush Society Statutory.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 38 years for Open Category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories (as on the last date of receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: District Programme Manager: AYUSH medical graduate with MBA in Health Care Management or equivalent and 3 years' public health experience; Ayush Medical Officer: MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa / Panchakarma); Yoga & Naturopathy: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration or M.Sc./B.Sc. Yoga or MA Yoga; Dietitian: B.Sc. Food & Nutrition / Home Science or PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science Graduation

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: 1) Medical Graduate in any AYUSH Stream (BAMS, BUMS, BHMS, BYNS) 2) MBA in Health Care Management/ Masters in Health/ Hospitals Administration/ Post diploma in Hospital & Health care Management (Two Years) from AICTE recognized institute. 3) Minimum 3 Year working experience in public health programme. Exposure in social sector schemes/ missions at national, state and district level. 4) Computer knowledge including MS office, MS Power Point, MS Excel. Experience required: Minimum 3 Year working experience in public health programme. Exposure in social sector schemes/ missions at national, state and district level. salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 60,000, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Detailed advertisement and application form are available on www.zpwardha.in.
Fill the application form and attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed for the post.
Attach a non-refundable demand draft of Rs. 150/- (Open category) of a nationalised bank payable to District Ayush Society Statutory, with your name written on its back.
Submit at the Inward-Outward Section, Office of the District Surgeon, District General Hospital, Wardha, from 27-11-2026 to 04-12-2026, 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM, excluding holidays.
Applications received by email will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ZP Wardha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ZP Wardha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 District Programme Manager, 1 Ayush Medical Officer, 1 Yoga & Naturopathy, 1 Dietitian.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ZP Wardha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form printed with the notice; also on www.zpwardha.in) and send it to Inward-Outward Section, Office of the District Surgeon, District General Hospital, Wardha, by by post or in person, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open category: Rs. 150 (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years for Open Category, 18 to 43 years for reserved categories (as on the last date of receipt of applications). Relaxation: Reserved categories Up to 43 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 35000 for District Programme Manager, Rs. 60,000 for Ayush Medical Officer, Rs. 28,000 (BNYS/ MCIM/ NCIM registration/ Paramedical Council registration); Rs. 20,000 (M.Sc./ B.Sc. Yoga or MA Yoga) for Yoga & Naturopathy, Rs. 20,000 for Dietitian.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: District Programme Manager: AYUSH medical graduate with MBA in Health Care Management or equivalent and 3 years' public health experience; Ayush Medical Officer: MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa / Panchakarma); Yoga & Naturopathy: BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration or M.Sc./B.Sc. Yoga or MA Yoga; Dietitian: B.Sc. Food & Nutrition / Home Science or PG Diploma in Dietetics after Science Graduation. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a domicile of Maharashtra. Must be physically and mentally fit with no criminal case registered. Character certificate to be submitted within one month. Council registration renewal certificate or receipt of application for registration must be attached.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with more than two living children will not be selected. Reserved category applicants without caste validity certificate will not be considered under reserved category. Applications without prescribed eligibility, without caste certificate or with unclear documents or marksheets will be rejected.

faq.answer: Scrutiny of documents attached with the application. Merit marks out of 100 (qualifying exam 50, higher qualification 20, experience 30). Category-wise merit list. Verification of original documents before appointment.
